ticker_news.title: Tesla Stock Is Falling, and Uber Stock Is Soaring
ticker_news.description: Tesla and Uber are experiencing divergent stock performances, with investors showing preference for companies demonstrating tangible success over those promising future technologies.
ticker_news.author: Parkev Tatevosian, Cfa

ticker_news.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of Tesla, Inc. - TSLA
ticker_news.description: Tesla launched its robotaxi service in Austin, Texas, but faced potential regulatory scrutiny after the NHTSA contacted the company regarding reports of erratic autonomous vehicle behavior, leading to a sharp stock price decline.
ticker_news.author: Pomerantz Llp
